title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 2.23 (versions follow prime numbers; 223 after 211): who it is, by all it does. Asked about someone, Luma now answers with what her books say the subject does and is, as Razar's reader of 2026-11-07 did (the subject's thread as a paragraph, guided by the question's word, by levels, nothing the question already says) and as Razar's design left open (D85, the frame of a person). The subject is the word of what was said that her books carry a talk by the most (her measure of 2.11), said in two lines or more; every line of her books where it stands, what follows it is counted by that next word and its first clause kept; her paragraph puts first what follows with a word the asker said (his 'es' leads to what it is), then what her books say most, up to four, never a clause all of whose words the asker already said. Measured in a copy with the answering branch forced (a test build, not published): 'que hizo Pablo?' -> 'Pablo y sus companeros llegaron a Perge de Panfilia, se levanto y, pidiendo silencio con un gesto, dijo, de pie, en medio del Areopago...', about 2.5 s an answer, no crash in 8 questions. Stated limits: what follows the subject is not always something it does ('Pedro y a su hermano'); the essence needs her books to say 'X es'; no chained conclusions yet. The kernel is unchanged since 1.39. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v2.23: Luma contesta quién es alguien por todo lo que hace, en un párrafo suyo. Prototipo de investigación.
